summary: Scinai Immunotherapeutics Ltd. filed a 6-K reporting a private placement of ADSs and warrants with accredited investors under Regulation D. The offering includes 5,208,333 ADSs at $0.48 per ADS, plus Series A and B warrants exercisable at $0.48 and $0.55, respectively, with beneficial ownership caps of 4.99% or 9.99%. A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners served as exclusive financial advisor, receiving a 7% cash fee. This capital-raising transaction does not fit standard special situations categories like acquisitions or restructuring, as it is a routine equity issuance by a foreign private issuer.
